definitions.gloss: to understand each other; to understand one another
definitions.explanation: Of two or more people or groups: to come to understand each other's feelings, positions, or ways of thinking. Built from {理解|りかい}する (to understand) and the suffix 〜{合|あ}う (to do mutually).

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{理解|りかい}し{合|あ}えた。
examples.english: We were able to understand each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}えば→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧、⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧{理解|りかい}し{合|あ}える⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧だ。
examples.english: If we talk it over, we should surely be able to understand each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}って→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{理解|りかい}し{合|あ}うこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Even when our cultures differ, it is important to understand each other's ways of thinking.

notes:
The potential form {理解|りかい}し{合|あ}える (to be able to understand each other) is especially common, as is the negative {理解|りかい}し{合|あ}えない (cannot understand each other).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{理解|りかい}し{合|あ}う: to understand one another
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{理解|りかい}し{合|あ}う: to understand each other's feelings
- ⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{理解|りかい}し{合|あ}う: to understand each other's positions
- {理解|りかい}し{合|あ}える⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: a relationship of mutual understanding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分|わ}かり{合|あ}う→分かり合う：32291_wakariau⟧: to understand each other — more everyday and emotional
- ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧: to talk things over — the discussion, not the understanding it leads to
